description: Read a Cloud page, Studio source, or Mobile Expo draft this account owns. Save replaces Studio source or a Mobile draft and does not publish, start an EAS build, or charge. A Mobile save requires expectedUpdatedAt from the last get or save. Publish Cloud HTML with deploy. Code has no server-side project. Data tables and records use the database tool.

draft.description: Full Mobile builder draft, version 1. A save replaces the stored draft.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Required for a Mobile save. Use updated_at from the last get or save.

files.description: Studio source map. index.html is required. Paths end in html, css, js, json, md, or svg.

html.description: Studio preview. A complete HTML document. Cloud pages are published with deploy.

name: project
title: Read or save a project
